tool: NØXERA SOC Lab - Authentication Log Analyzer

alerts.title: Repeated SSH authentication failures
alerts.evidence: 6 failed SSH logins from this IP occurred within 10 minutes.
recommended_triage: Confirm the source IP and time window in the original logs.
Check whether targeted accounts are privileged or valid.
Review firewall, VPN, and endpoint logs for related activity.
Escalate according to the organization's incident-response process.

alerts.title: Successful SSH login after repeated failures
alerts.evidence: A successful SSH login followed 6 failed login(s) from the same IP within 10 minutes.
recommended_triage: Verify the login with the account owner and check whether it was expected.
Review surrounding authentication and endpoint events.
Check for privilege changes, new keys, and unusual follow-on activity.
Escalate and contain only according to approved procedures and evidence.

alerts.title: Possible SSH password spraying across multiple accounts
alerts.evidence: Failed SSH logins targeted 5 distinct accounts from one IP within 10 minutes.
recommended_triage: Confirm whether the source IP is expected or belongs to approved infrastructure.
Review authentication results for each targeted account and related hosts.
Check for successful logins from the source IP and for activity across other systems.
Escalate according to the organization's incident-response process; do not block solely on this alert.

analyst_note: Alerts are leads for investigation, not proof of compromise. Traditional syslog timestamps omit the year; this lab assigns the current UTC year.
